compatibility.previously_valid_requests: Existing documented requests and default worker behavior remain supported.
compatibility.strict_validation: Unknown action/workspace fields, missing required fields and illegal JSON types now fail locally with field_errors before remote routing.
compatibility.metadata_extensions: ExperimentSpec project/runtime/resources/outputs/evaluation/success/automation and command metadata remain extensible.
compatibility.dynamic_constraints: Worker existence, admission, capabilities, filesystem confinement and exact staged hashes are evaluated at execution time.
compatibility.bounded_pages: New page options require page capabilities. Legacy lists remain supported with bounded transport errors on oversized responses.

worker.health.summary: Read diagnostic health from one selected worker.
constraints: Empty payload preserves the gateway default diagnostic worker. Explicit worker_id selects that exact worker; disabled workers remain readable.

worker.monitor.summary: Read diagnostic monitor from one selected worker.
constraints: Empty payload preserves the gateway default diagnostic worker. Explicit worker_id selects that exact worker; disabled workers remain readable.

worker.alerts.summary: Read diagnostic alerts from one selected worker.
constraints: Empty payload preserves the gateway default diagnostic worker. Explicit worker_id selects that exact worker; disabled workers remain readable.

worker.storage.summary: Read diagnostic storage from one selected worker.
constraints: Empty payload preserves the gateway default diagnostic worker. Explicit worker_id selects that exact worker; disabled workers remain readable.

worker.processes.summary: Read diagnostic processes from one selected worker.
constraints: Empty payload preserves the gateway default diagnostic worker. Explicit worker_id selects that exact worker; disabled workers remain readable.

run.snapshot.summary: Observe the current Run status and optional worker facts.
constraints: Uses explicit worker_id, otherwise the controller Run record; an unregistered Run in a multi-worker pool requires worker_id.
Optional observation/progress/evidence fields are absent or null when the worker does not provide them.

run.events.summary: Read events after an exclusive sequence cursor, optionally with bounded pages.
constraints: Uses explicit worker_id, otherwise the controller Run record; an unregistered Run in a multi-worker pool requires worker_id.
Supply limit or max_bytes to opt into capability-negotiated bounded pages. Legacy requests without page options keep their list shape.
next_cursor points only past delivered items. has_more permits immediate continuation; truncated means the byte budget ended the page.
A first item exceeding max_bytes fails with PAGE_ITEM_TOO_LARGE and no cursor advancement; increase max_bytes within the limit or select a narrower result.
Paged reads require run.events.page>=1; after_seq is the last delivered event sequence.
Uses explicit worker_id, otherwise the controller Run record; an unregistered Run in a multi-worker pool requires worker_id.

run.artifacts.summary: Read artifact metadata with optional bounded path-keyset pagination.
constraints: Uses explicit worker_id, otherwise the controller Run record; an unregistered Run in a multi-worker pool requires worker_id.
Supply limit or max_bytes to opt into capability-negotiated bounded pages. Legacy requests without page options keep their list shape.
next_cursor points only past delivered items. has_more permits immediate continuation; truncated means the byte budget ended the page.
A first item exceeding max_bytes fails with PAGE_ITEM_TOO_LARGE and no cursor advancement; increase max_bytes within the limit or select a narrower result.
Paged reads require run.artifacts.page>=1. cursor is opaque and bound to the run and path filter.
Inventory is live: additions after the current lexical path cursor appear in later pages; restart at cursor=null to discover earlier additions. This is not an immutable snapshot.

run.submit.summary: Submit one idempotent Run to the explicitly selected worker.
constraints: Multi-worker submission requires worker_id; single-worker requests may omit it.
Mutation requires dry-run then exact gateway confirm_plan_sha256 with unchanged request identity, actor and payload.
Evidence-bound commands require absolute Python and .py entry paths (optional -u/-B); evaluation must run inside that entry.
No automatic mutation retry; query/reconcile original operation or idempotency key after an unknown result.

run.pause.summary: Request a cooperative checkpoint-before-stop handshake for one opted-in Run.
constraints: Requires run.pause=1 and task.pause opt-in to managed-checkpoint-v1. Legacy workers are rejected; this is not the legacy run.cancel exception.
Uses explicit worker_id, otherwise the controller Run record; an unregistered Run in a multi-worker pool requires worker_id. No alternate account or worker is substituted.
Mutation requires dry-run then exact confirm_plan_sha256 with unchanged request identity, actor and payload. request_id binds the durable worker pause receipt.
A confirmed requested receipt confirms delivery, not a saved checkpoint or stopped training. Read run.snapshot pause and checkpoint facts until the handshake completes.

Timeout or invalid checkpoint acknowledgement never authorizes forced cancellation. Unknown delivery requires operation.query and run.snapshot inspection; do not automatically resend or use a new request identity.
Resume is an independently approved new run.submit with validated checkpoint input and source_run_id lineage, not a restart of the paused Run.

run.cancel.summary: Cancel one selected Run with an audit reason.
constraints: Uses explicit worker_id, otherwise the controller Run record; an unregistered Run in a multi-worker pool requires worker_id.

checkpoint.replicate.summary: Create a verified controller checkpoint replica.
constraints: Uses explicit worker_id, otherwise the controller Run record; an unregistered Run in a multi-worker pool requires worker_id.

checkpoint.import.summary: Import a verified replica into the selected target worker.
constraints: Imports bytes only; successful import does not prove model state restoration or grant permission to run training.

workspace.execute.summary: Execute a read or staged workspace operation through the selected worker.
constraints: inspect/diff/changes are read; stage/apply/restore/discard are mutation.
Multi-worker workspace operations require worker_id. Nested workspace hashes are separate from gateway confirm_plan_sha256.
Unknown nested fields are rejected locally; dynamic filesystem/configuration/hash checks remain on the worker.

fleet.status.summary: Observe all configured workers without automatic selection.
constraints: Observation concurrency is capped at four with total and per-worker time budgets.
Timed-out workers report WORKER_OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT. Exhausted capacity reports WORKER_OBSERVATION_BUSY; retry reads later.
Observation cancellation affects local SSH reads only; it never cancels training or changes worker admission.
No remote query; latest records are first.
Exactly one selector is required. query is local; reconcile may read the original worker and update local bookkeeping.
reconcile currently supports run.submit only. Missing worker receipt preserves unknown state and does not authorize retry.

operation.reconcile.summary: Reconcile a submission receipt without dispatching another Run.
constraints: Exactly one selector is required. query is local; reconcile may read the original worker and update local bookkeeping.
reconcile currently supports run.submit only. Missing worker receipt preserves unknown state and does not authorize retry.

gateway.describe.summary: Query packaged contracts locally without a worker, database, SSH or network.
constraints: workspace_action requires action workspace.execute.
This action is local-only and does not append remote or local execution audit records.
Project must exist under configured worker workspace_roots; the controller does not access the worker filesystem during validation.
Missing/null/empty/dot path means the project root for list/tree/search. read requires an explicit non-root relative path to a regular text file of at most 1 MiB.
Symlinks, credentials and version-control contents remain subject to worker confinement checks.
Only fields used by the selected mode are permitted; formerly ignored fields are rejected.
Existing change_id; generated diff is truncated at 256 KiB.
limit 1..200 (default 100); returns recorded change summaries, not a cursor-paginated collection.
1..128 unique normalized POSIX relative paths, write/trash only. UTF-8 text is at most 1 MiB per file and 16 MiB per change.
Trash requires an existing regular file. expected_sha256, when non-null, must match the current content.
Protected data/model/credentials/control paths and symlinks are rejected by the worker. No source file changes until apply.
Existing staged change and its exact workspace plan_sha256 are required.
Source hashes must still match staging; worker rollback protects partially applied files.
Existing applied change and its exact applied_sha256 are required.
Current hashes must match the applied state; later user edits are not overwritten.
Existing staged change and its exact workspace plan_sha256 are required. Discards overlay only.

experimentSpec.description: Known execution fields are validated; metadata objects remain extensible. Null optional metadata objects normalize to empty objects. Unknown top-level metadata is retained by the contract but may be ignored by ExperimentSpec normalization.
